_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Moves bank-statement import off the Financial overview dashboard (it was a prominent NcButton in FinancialDashboardActions.vue) into the top-level 'Configuratie' group as a custom page. The page (kind:page BankImportPage in src/registry.js) hosts the BankStatementWizard behind a launch button so importing statements lives with the other one-time setup tasks. The menu leaf is merged into the existing 'Configuratie' group by id (mergeMenuItems in main.js).

pages.title: Import bank statements
pages._note: Launcher for the multi-step BankStatementWizard modal (upload CAMT.053 / MT940 / CSV, then parse, preview and reconcile against invoices and bills). The wizard writes transactions but the page itself edits no object: `type: form` renders one flat field set against one schema and has no notion of an upload-parse-preview-commit sequence, and `type: index` would LIST statements rather than import them. Grouping into 'Configuratie' comes from the menu leaf above, not from the page.
